subject: Matemática
description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas que envolvam a partilha de uma quantidade em duas partes desiguais, envolvendo relações aditivas e multiplicativas, bem como a razão entre as partes e entre uma das partes e o todo.

components.description_pt: Particionar uma quantidade em duas partes desiguais usando relacionamentos aditivos
components.description_en: Partition a quantity into two unequal parts using additive relationships

components.description_pt: Determinar a razão entre as duas partes desiguais de uma quantidade particionada
components.description_en: Determine the ratio between the two unequal parts of a partitioned quantity
components.cc_component_description: Use ratio language to describe a ratio relationship between two quantities

components.description_pt: Determinar a razão entre cada parte e o todo em um problema de partição
components.description_en: Determine the ratio between each part and the whole in a partition problem
components.cc_component_description: Recognize that when the interval 0 to 1 is partitioned into b equal parts, each part has size 1/b

components.description_pt: Construir problemas envolvendo a partição de uma quantidade em duas partes desiguais
components.description_en: Construct problems involving the partition of a quantity into two unequal parts

cc_matches.description: Represent a fraction $\frac{1}{b}$ on a number line diagram by defining the interval from 0 to 1 as the whole and partitioning it into b equal parts. Recognize that each part has size $\frac{1}{b}$ and that the endpoint of the part based at 0 locates the number $\frac{1}{b}$ on the number line.

Understand the concept of a ratio and use ratio language to describe a ratio relationship between two quantities. *For example, "The ratio of wings to beaks in the bird house at the zoo was 2:1, because for every 2 wings there was 1 beak." "For every vote candidate A received, candidate C received nearly three votes."*
